svg.text: How the ePI pieces fit, layer by layer
Each ePI Type keeps everything from the layers above it and adds the next layer
Bundle (type = document) · one ePI = one Bundle
Product identification: what the label is about
Clinical information: what the label says, as data
coded with SNOMED CT, MedDRA and other terminologies
Dynamic digital label: every statement linked to its data
Each Topic carries its narrative text plus section.entry references to the exact resources it describes,
so a sentence about a contraindication points to that ClinicalUseDefinition, and a strength to that Ingredient.
Arrows point from a resource to the resource it references.
